title: Kim Kardashian stuns in dramatic Dalmatian polka-dot gown in Rome
text:

 Morgan Evans USA TODAY Updated Oct. 26, 2026, 1:33 p.m. ET Hear this story Kim Kardashian latest look is a polka-dot show-stopper. Period.
 The Skims founder, who recently celebrated her 46th birthday , is living la dolce vita in Rome, while celebrating the premiere of " All's Fair" Season 2 in a one-of-a-kind polka-dotted ensemble.
 Kardashian stepped out for the show's premiere event on Sunday, Oct. 25, in a custom version of one of Galia Lahav’s fall 2027 wedding gowns, less than two weeks after the gown made its runway debut at New York Bridal Fashion Week.
 With the help of stylist and image architect Law Roach , the reality star worked with the fan-favorite bridal brand to design the ivory-and-black polka dot creation, which featured a sculpted strapless corset bodice with daring lace-edged hip cut-outs, a gathered column skirt and a sweeping cathedral train. Kardashian let the bold gown speak for itself, opting for no jewelry and keeping her hair simple with a slicked-back ponytail.
 On Monday, Oct. 26, the star shared a series of photos of the custom gown on Instagram, including a snap of herself posing with two Dalmatians — the perfect complement to her spotted gown.
 The star cleverly captioned the post, "Spotted in Rome."
 Meanwhile, Roach shared the star's dotted look his on Instagram, simply captioning the post, "Period."
 Like mother, like daughter: Kim Kardashian dresses as daughter North West for Halloween. See the look As a lover of a fashion theme, the star stunned in another animal-inspired look the day before the "All's Fair" premiere, at the Rome Film Festival on Saturday, Oct. 24. Kardashian walked the red carpet in a vintage leopard-print gown from Saint Laurent's haute couture fall 1986 collection. The form-fitting gown featured a lace-up, plunge sweetheart bodice and a sleek column skirt, and she wore a matching shawl draped over her head and shoulders.
 Since teaming up with Roach this summer, Kardashian has worked with the legendary stylist on curating a series of memorable vintage looks. One of the star's most-talked-about style moments was her homage to Old Hollywood at this year's Academy Museum Gala .
 At the annual fundraising event for the Academy Museum of Motion Pictures in Los Angeles, Kardashian wowed in an elegant pink-and-white strapless Balenciaga gown from 1951. The archival dress featured a retro column silhouette made up of tiered ivory lace, equipped with a baby pink ribbon at the top of the bodice that extended into a giant back bow that cascaded behind her.
 Sourced from luxury vintage L.A. vintage salon Lily et Cie, the dress was described by the retailer as "exquisite couture" that "takes a page from Elizabeth Taylor’s playbook."
 "Tonight, Kim is a billboard advertising her own great taste. Her own great taste. Kim joins the ranks of Mona von Bismarck, Gloria Guinness, Ava Gardner, and the other remarkable women Balenciaga dressed," Lily et Cie captioned a video of Kardashian in the iconic dress.
